title: Figure 8: Transmission Electron Microscope Image of Graphene Flakes
description: Grayscale transmission electron microscope (TEM) image of crumpled, overlapping few-layer graphene flakes with a 100 nm scale bar at lower left. Caption reads 'Transmission Electron Microscope Image of Graphene. This could be an excellent ultracapacitor electrode material with its high surface area and excellent conductivity.'
